title: Comparison of diagnostic methods for tuberculosis in hospitalized patients: a retrospective analysis of laboratory- and pathology-based methods
summary: The aim of this retrospective study is to systematically compare the diagnostic methods used at the Krefeld site, evaluate their diagnostic performance, and identify potential areas for improvement in daily clinical practice. The results are intended to help inform evidence-based decisions regarding the further development of TB diagnostics.

interventions.name: A retrospective analysis of all patients who underwent tuberculosis testing between 2015 and 2025 and for whom at least one procedure was performed in both departments (Laboratory and Pathology).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
This includes all cases in which at least one diagnostic procedure (microscopic examination, culture, molecular detection via PCR, or histopathological findings) was performed.
Exclusion criteria:
lack of diagnostic testing in one of the two departments involved
